findings.evidence: `rg -n "primitive through|single primitive|derived from|re-proved"` hits `Basic.lean:201-203`, plus the same proof/refactor wording in module docs at `Basic.lean:31-36`, `FunctionClosure.lean:15-16`, and `FunctionKernel.lean:17-19`.
findings.fix: Limit the docstring to the exported result, e.g. that a positive-definite function induces the kernel `fun a b => F (a + star b)` and this is the forward half of the correspondence; move proof-architecture notes out of declaration docstrings.
findings.issue: The public docstring for `IsPositiveDefinite.isPositiveDefiniteKernel` says the theorem is “the primitive through which” later API is derived, which documents implementation/proof architecture rather than the theorem’s result and overstates this theorem as a primitive.

summary: The added documentation is mostly present, but it repeatedly describes proof/refactor mechanics as if they were part of the documented API, and one public theorem docstring overclaims the theorem's role.
